scope: S6 calibration; 100 disjoint runs per selected character configuration

protocol.checkpointBuild: Engine primary STR/DEX/ENE alternates VIT; Paladin uses STR/VIT in this existing policy
protocol.backend: memory repository; real service/combat/fairness with disposable SQLite economy
protocol.resumeValidation: once_per_run; separate real SQLite persistence and stale retry tests
protocol.winDefinition: Final boss defeated and player alive; reaching floor 999 alone is not a win

caveats: Same seed reused to tune coefficients; selected results are calibration, not an independent holdout despite the seed name.
100 runs cannot establish a true 30–35% population rate. Wilson intervals are descriptive and do not account for parameter selection.
S0 was tested for deterministic compatibility, not rerun statistically. Historical ~11% S0 is not a fresh comparison.
No dedicated S1–S5 statistical samples, optimized build sweep, external diamond funding or deliberate LR chains.
Five Druid shards repeat the same 100 trial1 runs and are checked for exact equality; never pooled.
Source fingerprints are retained separately. Later formatting and UI/test/doc edits do not alter the measured mechanics.
